name: AiChatDrawer
title: Blocks/Ai/AiChatDrawer
summary: The generative AI assistant in a right-side drawer over a resource page, so the reader asks about what they are looking at without leaving it: a workload page (`PageHeader` with an Agent `Button`, the name the console header gives the assistant, a `Card` of `KeyValueList` with a `StatusIndicator`) beside a medium `Drawer` that is not modal from `lg` (no overlay), so the page stays readable, and modal below `lg`, where it covers the page, whose `PanelHeader` holds `DrawerTitle`, a Preview `Tag`, New chat and the drawer's own close button. Inside, an `EmptyState` with support prompts about this workload (`SuggestionGroup`), then a `Conversation` with the reader's prompts in bubbles at the inline end and plain-text responses that think (`Reasoning`), stream (`StreamingResponse` with site-name citation chips) and carry Copy, Read aloud, Share and More (with Good response, Bad response, Try again and Branch in new chat) and a `Sources` pill on the same line, prompts with Copy and Edit, and `ResponseBranches` over their versions, and a `PromptInput` pill floating at the foot with the disclaimer until the first message, the thread on the canvas. Built from `Drawer`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerTitle`, `PanelHeader`, `ChatMessage`, `Conversation`, `PromptInput`, `IconButton`, `ResponseBranches` and `FeedbackReasonDialog`. Takes TanStack AI's `useChat` messages as they are. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot; inside ConsoleLayout on a wide screen the same conversation can go in the layout's tools region (`v-model:tools-open`) instead.
intents: asistente de ia en panel lateral

variants.name: Streaming
variants.summary: The drawer open on a response streaming in about the 502 errors of the workload behind it, with the caret, Stop in the composer and the busy region.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A response that failed mid-stream inside the drawer: the partial text, the error line and Try again.

variants.name: LongThread
variants.summary: Six earlier turns about the workload in the narrow drawer: the log opens on the newest response and Scroll to the latest message returns after scrolling up.
